title: Audio Recorder
requirements: start() validates mic permission, configures AVCaptureSession with single audio input, adds AVCaptureAudioFileOutput set to .m4a, creates parent directory, calls session.startRunning() and output.startRecording(to: url)
stop() is idempotent (early return if not recording), calls output.stopRecording(), waits for didFinishRecordingTo callback
Return RecordingHandle exposing elapsed time and Stop callback
On recordingFailed error, stash partial file as .m4a.partial
acceptance_criteria: start() throws permissionDenied when mic access is denied
stop() returns a valid .m4a file URL
stop() is idempotent—calling twice does not error
Output file is AAC in .m4a container
